title: Church Committee Final Report (1976)
summary: Senate Select Committee on Intelligence Activities: 126 meetings, ~800 witnesses, 110,000 documents. Found 'intelligence excesses, at home and abroad' spanning FDR to the early 1970s — CIA assassination plots (e.g. Castro), COINTELPRO, NSA SHAMROCK/MINARET monitoring Americans. Led to permanent intelligence committees and FISA (1978).
